# Shadow Priest — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Endgame build (level 60), 0/20/31 — respec at levels 42 and 60. The decision loop walks 84 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 51 (1 member), level 60 (1 member). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/priest/shadow/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). **GOOD** — 585% of the human spec median (327 vs 55.9 (n=21, 23-363) boss DPS over 7 boss fights); one bot, thin [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [shadow.md](./shadow.md).

## How the bots play it

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **S00u-wizard-oil — Apply Brilliant Wizard Oil:** The spec's own guide page names it (line 160); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **S00u-greater-arcane — Use Greater Arcane Elixir:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Greater Arcane Elixir (item 13454, required level 47), elixir or potion (aura 17539 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 164); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **S00u-dreamshard — Use Dreamshard Elixir:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Dreamshard Elixir (item 61224, required level 46), elixir or potion (aura 45427 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 164); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **S00u-mageblood — Use Mageblood Potion:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Mageblood Potion (item 20007, required level 40), elixir or potion (aura 24363 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 165); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **S00u-tea — Use Nordanaar Herbal Tea:** Restores 525 health and 810 mana (spell 19398, instant) and shares its 120 s category 1172 with the Dark and Demonic Runes; the guide names it as the mana cooldown beside the potions.
- **S00u-shadow-power — Use Elixir of Shadow Power:** Same shape as the HO-205 elixir and food rules: out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, the item in the bags and ready, and its aura 11474 missing (so again after a death).
- **S00u-danonzo-delight — Use Danonzo's Tel'Abim Delight:** Same shape as the HO-205 elixir and food rules: out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, the item in the bags and ready, and its aura 57044 missing (so again after a death).
- **S00f-fear-ward-tank-boss — Fear Ward:** HO-TKB-PLAY-155 (orchestrator, the fear bosses): the holy rule H00f in the shadow rotation too, which had no Fear Ward; a party with a shadow priest and no holy one now wards its tank. From holy: HO-TKB-PLAY-129 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d), rotation gaps for track 1 at level 22): "Fear Ward on the tank before fearing bosses" (priest/leveling.md L153; baseline for every race on Turtle, L252), on the tank while the tank readies a boss pull (party.pull_is_boss).
- **S00f2-fear-ward-tank-pull — Fear Ward:** HO-TKB-PLAY-155 (orchestrator, the fear bosses): the holy rule H00f in the shadow rotation too, which had no Fear Ward; a party with a shadow priest and no holy one now wards its tank. From holy: HO-TKB-PLAY-129 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d), rotation gaps for track 1 at level 22): "Fear Ward on the tank before fearing bosses" (priest/leveling.md L153; baseline for every race on Turtle, L252), on the tank while the tank readies a boss pull (party.pull_is_boss).
- **S00g-fear-ward-tank-feared — Fear Ward:** HO-TKB-PLAY-155 (orchestrator, p4-dungeon's mechanics audit: the fear bosses Dragonmaw Halgan, Stormwrought Balor and Halthas): Fear Ward on the tank in the fight once anyone is feared (party.any_feared), so the boss's next fear misses the tank ("Fear Ward on the tank before fearing bosses", priest/leveling.md L153). The ward does not break a fear already on the tank; it lasts 10 minutes or one fear, 30 s cooldown, 100 mana; `not aura_target(6346)` keeps a second priest from re-warding.
- **S01-shadowform — Shadowform:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **S02-fortitude — Power Word: Fortitude:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): `target: party_missing`: the nearest member in range and sight (the resident first, at 0 yd) lacking this buff's aura chain, instead of the lowest-health member; the one-member limit described below is gone. 30 min party buff, 50 mana, instant, no stancesNot so it survives Shadowform.
- **S02f-fade — Fade:** Holy's H02c with the threat gate added; Fade is a shadow spell, so Shadowform does not block it.
- **S03-inner-fire — Inner Fire:** 10 min self buff, 30 mana; no stancesNot, so it is kept in form too. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **S04-shield-self — Power Word: Shield:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **S17m-dispel-magic-must — Dispel Magic:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **S16m-abolish-disease-must — Abolish Disease:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **S06-psychic-scream — Psychic Scream:** HO-TKB-PLAY-084 (tear-play's review of TortoiseBots #436 and #437, relayed by the orchestrator; owner: fear is out of the dungeon CC scope): ALONE only. Psychic Scream is an area fear: in a party or an instance the feared mobs run into the next packs, and TortoiseBots bans it there.
- **S00s-mana-burn-10499 — Mana Burn:** Shadowform does not stop Mana Burn (Shadow school).
- **S00s-mana-burn-10471 — Mana Burn:** Shadowform does not stop Mana Burn (Shadow school).
- **S00s-mana-burn-10470 — Mana Burn:** Shadowform does not stop Mana Burn (Shadow school).
- **S13m-shackle-undead-moon — Shackle Undead:** HO-TKB-PLAY-120 (owner-approved, TortoiseBots review LEARN 1: crowd control on the party's CC mark): Shackle Undead on the Moon-marked mob when it is undead (targetCreatureType 32, `target.creature_type(6)`); 90 mana at rank 1, 1.5 s, 30 yd; ranks 9484, 9485, 10955; it breaks on damage like Polymorph. The guide: "Shackle Undead on an extra undead mob" in the dungeon list (guide/classes/priest/leveling.md L153, L188).
- **S13h-holy-nova-five-plus — Holy Nova:** In Shadowform Holy Nova damages the caster instead of healing the party (spell 15237 description, tkbplay-224.result.txt; the cast is the highest rank, 480 mana at rank 6): the priest's own health must be 60 per cent or more. Above SW:P and Mind Blast so the spam is not interrupted by single-target upkeep.
- **S11-mind-blast — Mind Blast:** HO-TKB-PLAY-116 (decision 177): priority 85, above Shadow Word: Pain (90): the guide's Shadow loop is Shadowform, shield, Mind Blast, Shadow Word: Pain, Mind Flay x2, wand to finish (L203-L207).
- **S09-shadow-word-pain — Shadow Word: Pain:** 25 mana for 18 s of damage and no cast time; the first thing on a new target. stances 134217728 with SPELL_ATTR_EX2_NOT_NEED_SHAPESHIFT set, so it is legal in and out of form.
- **S13a-shackle-undead-second — Shackle Undead:** HO-TKB-PLAY-038 (orchestrator; p1-loop v12 answers OQ-2817): Shackle Undead (9484, level 20, 90 mana, 1.5 s, 30 yd) on the OTHER attacker when it is UNDEAD (the spell''s targetCreatureType mask 32 = undead; `target.creature_type(6)`). The guide lists it among the priest''s undead extras and, in the level 20-29 notes, before fearing bosses.
- **S13-shadow-mend — Shadow Mend:** Instant, 270 mana, 30 s recoveryTime and no stancesNot, so it is the only heal this spec can cast without leaving Shadowform. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **S14-flash-heal-self — Flash Heal:** stancesNot 134217728: refused in Shadowform, so this is a rule of the pre-40 band. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **S15-renew-self — Renew:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **S16-abolish-disease — Abolish Disease:** Free at the pin, refused in Shadowform (stancesNot 134217728). DispelType 3 is disease.
- **S17-dispel-magic — Dispel Magic:** Free at the pin and, unlike the cures, it carries no stancesNot, so a shadow priest keeps its magic dispel in form. DispelType 1 is magic.
- **S18-resurrection — Resurrection:** Free, 10 s cast, refused in Shadowform. From 40 the shadow priest must drop form to res, which no rule does, so this one goes quiet; that is a real cost of the spec and is stated rather than papered over.
- **S19-smite — Smite:** The pre-40 filler; refused in Shadowform (stancesNot 134217728), 1.5 s cast, 20 mana.
